```{r}
set.seed(22)
h_com <- Heatmap(data, 
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        row_km = 18, 
        row_km_repeats = 10000,
        #cluster_rows = agnes_split,

        name = "min_max",
        show_row_names=FALSE)+

h_com <- draw(h_com)


## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_com)
anno <- data %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("ID") %>% select(ID)
anno$cluster_mz <- NA

library(foreach)
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$cluster_mz <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$cluster_mz)))
}
anno$cluster_mz <- unfactor(anno$cluster_mz)

## Add to SE
SE$cluster_mz <- anno$cluster_mz[match(SE$ID, anno$ID)]
```

```{r}
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

### Prepare MetaboAnalyst

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# FUNCTION 1: Perform logFC/p-value and t-score estimation
log_FC_analysis <- function(SE, x, group) {
  
  category_name <- paste0(x, "_other")
  
  # 1. Create the new category variable based on the input x
  SE[[category_name]] <- ifelse(SE[[group]] == x, x, "Other")
  
  # 2. Aggregate expression per category
  mean_SE <- aggregateAcrossCells(SE,
                                  ids = SE[[category_name]],
                                  statistics = "mean",
                                  use.assay.type = "min_max")
  
  # 3. Calculate log-fold change (logFC)
  logFC <- log2(assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == x] /
                assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[category_name]] == "Other"])
  
  # 4. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
  min_max <- as.data.frame(t(assay(SE, "min_max")))
  min_max[[category_name]] <- SE[[category_name]]
  
  p_value <- c()
  t_score <- c()
  for (i in 1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)) {
    t <- t.test(min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == x, i], 
                min_max[min_max[[category_name]] == "Other", i])
    p_value[i] <- t$p.value
    t_score[i] <- t$statistic
  }
  
  names(t_score) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  names(p_value) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 5. Adjust p-values for multiple testing (Optional)
  #p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  #names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  
  # 6. Prepare data for the volcano plot
  data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value))
  data$t_score <- t_score[match(rownames(data), names(t_score))]
  
  ## Custom Color
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    data$logFC < -0.2, "#377EB8",
    ifelse(data$logFC > 0.2, "#E41A1C", 'black')
  )
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- paste("High", x)
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Other'
  
  # 7. Plot VolcanoPlot
  p <- EnhancedVolcano(data,
                  lab = rownames(data),
                  x = 'logFC',
                  y = 'p_value',
                  title = '',
                  boxedLabels =FALSE,
                  pCutoff = 0.05,
                  FCcutoff = 0.2,
                  drawConnectors = FALSE,
                  pointSize = 8.0,
                  labSize = 6.0, 
                  colCustom = keyvals)
  
  return(list(plot = p, data = data))
}


# FUNCTION 2: Save csv file for each group
save_csv_for_GSEA <- function(SE, group, phenotype, output_path) {
  result <- log_FC_analysis(SE, group, phenotype)
  
  mz_ranked <- result$data %>% arrange(p_value) %>% dplyr::select(p_value, t_score)
  mz_ranked <- mz_ranked %>% rownames_to_column("m.z")
  colnames(mz_ranked) <- c("m.z", "p.value", "t.score")
  
  # Save
  write.csv(mz_ranked, output_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```

## 3. Metaclustering

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# Base directory
base_dir <- "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/GSEA/cluster_k_17/output"

# Get all out_* folders
out_folders <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read one out_* folder
read_out_folder <- function(folder) {
  # CSV file
  csv_file <- file.path(folder, "mummichog_pathway_enrichment_mummichog.csv")
  df <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "pathway"
  
  # JSON file
  json_file <- file.path(folder, "scattermum.json")
  jdat <- fromJSON(json_file)
  jdf <- tibble(
    path = unlist(jdat$pathnames),
    enr  = unlist(jdat$enr)
  )
  
  # Join CSV and JSON
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(jdf, by = c("pathway" = "path")) %>%
    mutate(group = basename(folder))
  
  return(df)
}

# Apply across all out_* folders and combine
all_results <- map_dfr(out_folders, read_out_folder)
```

```{r}
all_results$NES <- scale(all_results$enr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

all_results <- all_results %>% mutate(scaled_NES = NES*-log10(`P(Fisher)`))


result_mat <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, group, scaled_NES) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = scaled_NES, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% t() %>% as.matrix()

Heatmap(result_mat)
```


```{r}
library(clValid)
set.seed(22)
testCL<- clValid(result_mat,
                 nClust = 2:10,
                 #clMethods = c("kmeans"),
                 clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),
                 validation="internal", 
                 metric="euclidean", 
                 method = "ward", 
                 maxitems = 5000)
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Column Anno
# Match Pathway Annotation
pathway_anno <- peak_anno_updated %>% dplyr::select(hsa_name, hsa_class) %>% unique
(result_mat %>% colnames)[!(result_mat %>% colnames) %in% pathway_anno$hsa_name]

pathway_anno <- bind_rows(
  pathway_anno,
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Drug metabolism - other enzymes", hsa_class = "Xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Drug metabolism - cytochrome P450", hsa_class = "Xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Terpenoid backbone biosynthesis", hsa_class = "Metabolism of terpenoids and polyketides"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism", hsa_class = "Amino acid metabolism"),
  data.frame(hsa_name = "Glycolysis or Gluconeogenesis", hsa_class = "Carbohydrate metabolism")
)

col_anno <- data.frame(fine = colnames(result_mat))
col_anno$broad <- pathway_anno$hsa_class[match(col_anno$fine, pathway_anno$hsa_name)]
col_broad <- setNames(brewer.pal(10, "Paired"), unique(col_anno$broad))
col_anno_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(broad = anno_simple(col_anno$broad, col = col_broad),
                                 fine = anno_text(col_anno$fine))

## Print heatmap
set.seed(22)
h_meta <- 
  Heatmap(result_mat, 
          row_km = 9, 
          row_km_repeats = 100,
          #row_split = 3,
          clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
          clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
          column_title = NULL,
          column_split = col_anno$broad)%v%
  col_anno_ha

lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "Broad pathway",
                at = names(col_broad),
                legend_gp = gpar(fill = col_broad))


h_meta <- draw(h_meta, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_1))
```

```{r}
## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_meta)
anno <- result_mat %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("cluster") %>% select(cluster)
anno$cluster_mz <- str_split(anno$cluster, "out_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
anno$metacluster <- NA

library(foreach)
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$metacluster <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$metacluster)))
}
anno$metacluster <- unfactor(anno$metacluster)

## Add to SE
SE$metacluster <- anno$metacluster[match(SE$cluster_mz, anno$cluster_mz)]
```

```{r}
save_csv_for_GSEA <- function(SE, group, phenotype, output_path) {
  result <- log_FC_analysis(SE, group, phenotype)
  
  mz_ranked <- result$data %>% arrange(p_value) %>% dplyr::select(p_value, t_score)
  mz_ranked <- mz_ranked %>% rownames_to_column("m.z")
  colnames(mz_ranked) <- c("m.z", "p.value", "t.score")
  
  # Save
  write.csv(mz_ranked, output_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```
